The judgment from the international court of justice (ICJ) – which has never previously found a state responsible for genocide – ends a seven-year legal battle and is seen as a critical global test for dealing with the most serious of all state crimes. item.description: New Essendon player Archie Elliott came to draft night to support a mate, but got picked himself too. He didn’t expect to be drafted and was overcome with emotion when the Bombers got him pick No.17. “I’m super pumped I don’t even know what to say,” he said. Elliott was in tears afterwards, even though he said 15 clubs had spoken to him.
